from work import evaluate
p={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':7,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':False,'environment':True}
cases=[
('late_layer',{'layers':[{'i':'bad'},{'i':0}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':0,'s':'x'},'error':None}),
('env_repairs',{'layers':[{'i':'bad'}],'environment':{'i':'-0'}},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':0,'s':'x'},'error':None}),
('null_then_env',{'layers':[{'i':None}],'environment':{'i':'+12'}},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':12,'s':'x'},'error':None}),
('disabled_nonempty',{'environment':{'i':'1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),
('unknown_layer',{'layers':[{'z':1}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}),
('empty_env',{'environment':{}},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':7,'s':'x'},'error':None}),
]
for name,req,expected in cases:
 actual=evaluate(req,p if name!='empty_env' else {**p,'environment':False})
 assert actual==expected,(name,actual,expected)
print('6 independent precedence/boundary cases passed')
print('unicode_decimal',evaluate({'environment':{'i':'١٢'}},p))
